question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The guards will **watch** over the premises.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Protect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"watch"** has multiple meanings depending on the context. In this sentence, "watch" means to protect or guard over something (सुरक्षा करना).
 
 
• **Example:** The security guards watch over the museum during the night to ensure its safety.
 
 
• **"Protect"** is the correct word that matches the intended meaning of "watch" in this context (रक्षा करना).
 
 
• **Example:** The guards protect the premises from intruders and unauthorized access.
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate homonym for "watch" in this context is **"Protect."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Protect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Timepiece** (घड़ी): A device used to measure and indicate time.
 
 
• **Example:** He bought a new timepiece to keep track of his busy schedule.
 
 

 
• **Warn** (चेतावनी देना): To notify or alert someone about potential danger or risk.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast warned of heavy rain and thunderstorms.
 
 

 
• **Observe** (देखना): To watch or monitor something carefully.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientists observe the behavior of the animals in their natural habitat.
